summary: Both targets promoted to exact graft records in CLEAR CARD numbering. Ep 12 (Ice Ball Sports Tournament): the story is entirely anime-original; the secured card, Hail, is an anime-EXCLUSIVE card whose only manga presence is a background cameo in CC ch 39 (vol 8) among the Clear Cards circling Sakura — fandom flags that cameo as possibly a CLAMP error, and ch 39 itself is the Momo/Lilie-flashback chapter where Break debuts and is sealed (nothing of it is in ep 12). Anchored 39/39 v8 as a card-graft-only record. Ep 14 (Shrine and the Zoo): story likewise anime-original (Mirage shows Sakura her friends as animals; Syaoran stops time), but unlike Hail, Mirage later gets a GENUINE manga debut and capture in CC ch 46 (vol 10, released 2020-08-31, over two years after the episode): it manifests from Sakura's fear of her dream showing Syaoran as the cloaked figure and is sealed together with Dreaming — a completely different story. Anchored 46/46 v10. Both continue points stay at ch 17 (eps 12-16 are the anime-original block; the mainline resumes with ep 17 = ch 17). Refined the lumped eps-11/12/14 graft {39, 46} annotation into per-episode facts, and recovered the full Clear Card volume boundaries from Wikipedia (the context file had none).

anchors.note: Card-graft record, not story adaptation: Hail is anime-exclusive ('first manga: Chapter 39' = a cameo among the Clear Cards circling Sakura, which fandom notes may be a CLAMP error); CC ch 39 (vol 8) itself — Momo, Lilie flashback, Break debut/sealed, Shadow/Flight — has no counterpart in ep 12. Episode secures Hail via Syaoran's covert Firey summon; Wikipedia's episode list confirms Hail as ep 12's card. Type anime-only-canon stands.

Card-graft record: Mirage 'prior to Chapter 46 was an anime-exclusive card' — its true manga debut/capture is CC ch 46 (vol 10, 2020-08-31), where it manifests from Sakura's dream-fear of Syaoran as the cloaked figure and is sealed with Dreaming (Reflect/Record used). Ep 14's shrine/zoo animal-illusion story and Syaoran's time-stop are anime-original; only the card is shared. Wikipedia's episode list confirms Mirage as ep 14's card. Type anime-only-canon stands.
